scope: Re-audit of Greater Angkor's exact sampled crop/water labels after the cell-by-crop hydrology closure, keeping dated archaeological features separate from observed-cropland predictors.

crop_water_label_audit.source_semantics: Each crop/mode label is sourced from paired low-input rain-fed/irrigated GAEZ semantics or the same-geography physical fallback; a no-reachable-water zero is retained as structural rather than copied from rain-fed data.
crop_water_label_audit.audit_note: The earlier wave14 diagnostic referenced a stale 32-row aggregate table. The canonical cell-by-crop artifact now contains all 736 required rows and is hash-linked by the physical closure audit.

current_mechanistic_diagnostic.interpretation: The physical label contract is closed, but the score still lacks a dated Angkor-specific rice calendar, flood-recession/deepwater-rice treatment, and a source-backed hydraulic technology efficiency. Those are model feature/uncertainty questions, not missing crop labels and not reasons to alter the 700,000-person historical floor.

historical_feature_evidence.value: approximately 1000 km2 of Angkor-period rice fields and approximately 22000 km of bunds
historical_feature_evidence.use: technology/context validation and dated irrigation-system parameter research; do not copy observed historical field share into all feasible 1337 land

historical_feature_evidence.value: independent study cited by Klassen et al. estimates approximately 750000 people could be supported by rice produced within the Greater Angkor Region without irrigation
historical_feature_evidence.use: corroboration of the one-sided 700000-person lower bound; not a new capacity target or multiplier

historical_feature_evidence.value: barays, canals, bunds, reservoirs and community ponds managed water across the agricultural metropolitan area
historical_feature_evidence.use: dated technology registry and uncertainty scenarios; no direct population fitting

remaining_scientific_work.required_resolution: Represent Tonle Sap/lowland seasonal water and rice-calendar scenarios with cited pre-1337 evidence, without treating modern cropland as historical truth.
Estimate shared, uncertainty-bounded effects of gravity conveyance, barays, bunds, ponds and water-level management; no Angkor-specific multiplier.
Use cited Tonle Sap/pond fisheries evidence only as a separate ecological cap, never double-counting cropland calories.

acceptance_effect.reason_final_deployment_blocked: Grouped lower-bound coverage and correlated physical uncertainty gates still fail; this follow-up closes the stale Angkor cell-label contract but does not claim that the current generic physical model has explained the historical lower bound.

notes: This is an append-only physical follow-up, not a replacement for the vetted lower-bound evidence packet. It distinguishes closed crop/water labels from unresolved dated feature and uncertainty work and prevents the obsolete 32-row '__unresolved__' diagnostic from being used as evidence that Cairo/Angkor data are missing.
